segments.ja265:1.1: Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne, khagge gahīte tikhiṇe teladhote;
segments.ja265:1.3: Tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe, kasmā nu te nāhu chambhitattaṃ.
segments.ja265:2.1: Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne, khagge gahīte tikhiṇe teladhote;
segments.ja265:2.3: Tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe, vedaṃ alatthaṃ vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ.
segments.ja265:3.1: So vedajāto ajjhabhaviṃ amitte, pubbeva me jīvitamāsi cattaṃ;
segments.ja265:3.3: Na hi jīvite ālayaṃ kubbamāno, sūro kayirā sūrakiccaṃ kadācīti.
